clue.text: Slip out of place for endless sex after drink

indicators.note: after sends the shortened sex to follow the drink word

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of
to lap is to drink as a cat does

indicators.note: endless says the word sex loses its final letter

explanation.surface: A disapproving note about someone who has sex after drinking, as if it were a slip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' cuts the last letter from sex; 'after' sends that piece to follow the drink word.
explanation.definitionFit: Medically, an organ that prolapses slips down out of its normal position.

clue.text: See 17
Don't judge a book by its cover — Playboy seeks it in nude spread

definitions.text: Don't judge a book by its cover

indicators.note: a spread is laid out anew, so these letters are rearranged, with a magazine centrefold pun

explanation.surface: Playboy magazine hunts for its ideal within a naked centrefold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spread' signals the anagram of PLAYBOYSEEKSITINNUDE, twenty letters across the three lights.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are proverbs warning that outward appearance is no guide to real worth.

clue.text: One stops slips — bowled at helmet taking maiden

parts.note: B is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for bowled

indicators.note: taking means the hat word takes another piece inside it

parts.note: a helmet is a kind of hat
M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: A cricket scene: slips fielders, a batsman bowled, a helmet and a maiden over.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket 'slips' are fielders, which pulls away from the bathroom floor.
explanation.definitionFit: A non-slip mat beside the tub prevents people sliding on a wet floor.

clue.text: Spoken occasionally within four walls

indicators.note: occasionally means taking only every other letter of the words four walls

explanation.surface: Something said now and then in a private room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'within' is just a link; the alternate letters of 'four walls' starting from the second give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: An oral exam or agreement is one delivered by voice rather than in writing.

clue.text: Intimate Secrets blue movie, at last — left pub to provide case

parts.note: blue means smutty or dirty

indicators.note: the pub word provides a case, wrapping round the letter taken

parts.note: an inn is a pub

indicators.note: at last picks the final letter of movie

explanation.surface: A blue film's last scene reveals private secrets as evidence in a court case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to provide case' puts E inside INN to make INEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Washing your dirty linen in public is an idiom for airing private embarrassments.

clue.text: See 20
Bit of adultery? The man's reason for going red

indicators.note: bit of means the letters lie within the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: Is an affair the reason this man is blushing?
explanation.definitionFit: This medical term names a reddening of the skin from blood flushing the capillaries.

clue.text: Read "Help" — iPad needs original leads only for charger

indicators.note: original leads only says to take just the first letter of each word from Read to original

explanation.surface: Instructions for an iPad: read the help page; only use the original charging leads.
explanation.walkthrough: 'original' supplies the last letter too, as part of the run: R, H, I, N, O.
explanation.definitionFit: A charger is an animal that charges, and this horned beast famously does.

clue.text: Sweet thing, female round JFK?

parts.note: a lap is one round of a racetrack
Jack was the familiar name of President John F Kennedy

explanation.surface: Was some woman around Kennedy his sweetheart? A hint at Monroe.
explanation.walkthrough: A flapjack is a British oat-and-syrup bar.
explanation.definitionFit: A flapjack is a chewy oaty confection, so a sweet treat.

clue.text: Padding reply out, she doesn't end break up

indicators.note: break up says the letters are broken apart and reassembled
doesn't end drops the last letter of the word she

explanation.surface: Stretching out a reply because she won't end the relationship.
explanation.walkthrough: SH (she without her end) joins REPLY and OUT; 'break up' rearranges the lot.
explanation.definitionFit: The stuffing in sofas and chairs is the soft padding of their covering.

clue.text: Difficult to control increase with compassion

parts.note: to up something is to increase it
pity is compassion

explanation.surface: An unruly rise in compassion.
explanation.definitionFit: An arrogant, self-assertive person who will not keep their place is hard to manage.

clue.text: See 3
Part of "body found in …" (mostly lost) — Candle in the Wind

indicators.note: to wind is to twist, so these letters are wound into a new order
mostly means the word lost loses its last letter

explanation.surface: Marilyn Monroe, a body found lifeless, is remembered by Elton John's song Candle in the Wind.
explanation.walkthrough: LOS (lost, mostly) joins CANDLEINTHE; 'Wind' rearranges them. 'Wind' reads as part of the song title.
explanation.definitionFit: This cord at the back of the heel joins the calf muscle to the bone, a piece of anatomy.

clue.text: Sexy entertainer's no saint

indicators.note: no says a piece is removed from the host word

parts.note: a host entertains guests

explanation.surface: A seductive performer is no saint.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of entertainer's reads as 'is', a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Hot is slang for physically attractive or sexually exciting.

clue.text: Speak from text on the radio — temporary defence

indicators.note: on the radio means the words are heard, so a sound-alike is wanted

parts.note: to read out is to speak aloud from a text

explanation.surface: A broadcaster reading a script on air, with a mention of makeshift fortifications.
explanation.definitionFit: A small, often temporary fortified outwork is the military term for this structure.

clue.text: Picture small cleavage for breast augmentation …

indicators.note: cleavage for says the small letter splits the breast word apart

parts.note: bust means the breasts
breast augmentation is a cosmetic operation, an op

explanation.surface: An image of modest cleavage, offered for breast enlargement.
explanation.walkthrough: Picture means a film: Bus Stop (1956) starred Marilyn Monroe.
explanation.definitionFit: A picture is a film, and this is a 1956 movie starring the puzzle's actress.

clue.text: Be faithful to start of Block-Heads cutting Laurel and Hardy's final pieces

parts.note: Stan Laurel was the thin half of the comedy duo Laurel and Hardy

indicators.note: cutting says the start letter cuts into the final pieces
final pieces takes the last letter of the words and and Hardy's
start of picks the first letter of Block-Heads

explanation.surface: Stay loyal to Block-Heads, a 1938 Laurel and Hardy film, cutting the duo's last scenes.
explanation.walkthrough: B (start of Block-Heads) goes between D and Y.
explanation.definitionFit: To stand by a person is to support them loyally through difficulty.

clue.text: … its members might get a reduced volume in breast, admitting "bad luck"

definitions.text: its members might get a reduced volume

indicators.note: admitting means the breast word lets the other letters inside

parts.note: boob is slang for a breast

indicators.note: bad says the letters of luck are mixed up

explanation.surface: Continuing the surgery theme: a smaller bust volume, plus bad luck.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reduced volume' means a discounted book, not a smaller bust; 'bad' is the anagram signal for luck, and 'admitting' puts the result inside the breast word.
explanation.definitionFit: Members of a reading society often buy their books at a discount.

clue.text: My minor role playing with an actress

indicators.note: playing means the letters are toying with their order

explanation.surface: An actress laments her small part.
explanation.definitionFit: She was a celebrated Hollywood film star of the 1950s, the theme's subject.

clue.text: Launcher of old institute, within Ed's charge, having lost vote

indicators.note: within puts one piece inside the politician's surname

parts.note: Ed Balls is a British Labour politician

indicators.note: having lost means the charge word drops a letter

parts.note: a tax is a charge levied
X is the mark made when casting a vote

explanation.surface: A politician, Ed, on charges and lost votes, with a nod to an old institute.
explanation.walkthrough: Ed Balls was Labour's shadow chancellor, a natural voice on tax; he lost his seat in 2015.
explanation.definitionFit: This was a Roman siege engine that hurled stones or bolts, an ancient missile launcher.

clue.text: Animate musical without limits

indicators.note: without limits removes the first and last letters of the musical

parts.note: Carousel is a Rodgers and Hammerstein stage musical

explanation.surface: Bring an exuberant show to life.
explanation.definitionFit: To animate someone is to stir or excite them into activity.

clue.text: See 14
Test score — dismissed

parts.note: a try is a score in rugby
a batsman who is dismissed is out

explanation.surface: A test match, the score, a batsman dismissed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Test' suggests a cricket Test match, but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A trial run or audition for a candidate is a test of their ability.

clue.text: It might be used when picking up it girl? Work on love first

definitions.text: It might be used when picking up

indicators.note: first places the love letter at the very front
on means the work comes immediately before the rest

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O
op is short for opus, a work
it means sex appeal, abbreviated SA
Daisy is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A chat-up line aimed at an It girl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'picking up' suggests seduction, but means lifting a fallen child.
explanation.definitionFit: This exclamation is said when lifting a toddler who has stumbled.

clue.text: See 3
See 10
Furnish my lover's toilet

definitions.meaning: David Furnish is married to Elton ..., so his lover is the singer
a slang word for a lavatory

explanation.surface: Kit out a lover's bathroom.
explanation.walkthrough: Furnish is a surname here: David Furnish, husband of Elton John, who sang Candle in the Wind about Monroe.
explanation.definitionFit: Elton is the singer partnered with Furnish; and a lavatory is slangily named the same.

clue.text: European measurements written round collar

indicators.note: written round says the measurement word is written around another letter

parts.note: size means measurements or dimensions

explanation.surface: European collar sizes are written around the neck band.
explanation.definitionFit: To collar someone is to grab or arrest them, to take hold.

clue.text: Exposed in Which? — Oil of Olay eau conclusively invented "without signs of aging"

indicators.note: in places the exposed word inside the other letters
invented means the letters are made up afresh in a new order
conclusively takes the last letter of each word from Which? to eau

parts.note: out means exposed or revealed

explanation.surface: A consumer magazine exposes that an Olay cosmetic was invented to make skin look young.
explanation.walkthrough: 'invented' turns HLFYU into YHFUL, and OUT goes in it after the Y. Which? is a British consumer-testing magazine; Oil of Olay a skin cream.
explanation.definitionFit: Looking young means showing no wrinkles or other marks of age.
